question: If $\begin{vmatrix}a&b&c\\p&q&r\\x&y&z\end{vmatrix}=4$, determine $\begin{vmatrix}p&q&r\\2a&2b&2c\\x&y&z\end{vmatrix}$ without expansion. State each property used.
explanation:
Interchange of rows
Interchanging the first two rows changes the sign of the determinant. Therefore, $$\begin{vmatrix}p&q&r\\a&b&c\\x&y&z\end{vmatrix}=-4$$
Multiplication of one row
In the required determinant, the second row is twice the corresponding row. Multiplying one row by $2$ multiplies the determinant by $2$.
Required determinant
Hence, $$\begin{vmatrix}p&q&r\\2a&2b&2c\\x&y&z\end{vmatrix}=2(-4)=-8$$
